record_notes.DCP-LETT-1132: Sunday assigned October31,1847. Painful boils, Pompeii reading and improving health reported; Wednesday departure and Thursday arrival intended, Hooker visit anticipated. Thanks several missing Emma notes, one this morning, and answers gardening changes. Father gardening advice is oral. Original pencil overtraced in ink by Emma: material transmission layer, not automatically Emma-authored reply prose. Preserve visible Darwin alterations and overtracing provenance; no preserved incoming gardening letter.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1176: Saturday–Sunday May20–21,1848 under editorial itinerary. P1–2 Saturday, P3–7 Sunday. Explicit will not go today means first composition not dispatch. Saturday morning Emma note supplies children news; Sunday thanks may concern further notes and cannot backdate them to Saturday. Father optimistic prognosis and Catherine/Susan health/travel accounts attributed, not objective long-term outcome. Annie Mozart comparison is familial joke. Hensleigh free-will claim followed by Darwin hereditary-signature joke; do not flatten as settled scientific proof or conflate speakers. Barnacles sent by Emma, preservation advice in final postscript, not proof of every specimen examined. Missing Emma inputs and Susan oral account remain distinct.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1177: Monday assigned May22,1848. Withdraws earlier request for early newspapers, cannot read old papers and dislikes Globe; apparatus discussion of particular political articles is not proof of exactly which issue read. Father and own symptoms contemporary, skips cold bath because he believes it worsens later health; later enthusiasm for water cure must not rewrite this. Frank romance inferred from looks/silence, not established fact. Says Evelyn Godolphin read since arrival, while log records completion May31: earlier demonstrated reading retained, exact completion uncertain. Sévigné English translation currently read, edition unspecified. Emma story about Willy relayed to family, no surviving incoming letter.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1178: Tuesday assigned May23,1848. Children Willy/Annie notes and Emma letter separately thanked. Short Roman-cream passage read aloud quoted as Darwin reports it, not full incoming text. Father health mixed; private preference for rural home current. Erasmus note this morning with Fanny/party gossip is another missing input; attraction is Darwin inference, not direct stated fact. Children invitation deliberately left open, presents obtained. Current Sévigné appreciation not proof completed entire edition. No text to reconstruct family prompts.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1179: Thursday assigned May25,1848. Father health and Catherine departure reported; Owens are William Mostyn Owen family, not Richard Owen. Third note to chemist Blunt just written, contents missing. Erasmus joke about Lyells, Queen ball and Prince speech attributed and not evidence Darwin attended. Annie singing response follows missing Emma letter. Historical racialized self-description in closing is actual source language; later editorial endearment interpretation must remain apparatus, not replace or expand other abbreviations. Sévigné enthusiasm continues. No incoming family source identified.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1180: Saturday–Sunday May27–28,1848. P1 Saturday acknowledges morning Emma baby-health letter and reports own attack, deaths/family news, uncertain Monday travel. P2–4 Sunday acknowledges a further nice note, reports sleepless night and now abandons tomorrow departure. New Sunday information must not condition Saturday prose. Henrietta little letter thanked in final postscript, precise earlier receipt unknown. Baby identity Elizabeth distinct from adult Elizabeth supporting Emma. Later June1 return not completed at either dateline. No missing Emma or child text reconstructed.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1208: Three oclock at Park Street, assigned November17,1848. Arrival, rest and affection to Emma; no explicit incoming letter prompt. Emma verso note establishes November1848 Shrewsbury journey, narrower day supplied editorially in funeral itinerary. Letter does not state all funeral details or Erasmus whereabouts; keep apparatus apart. Health and emotional support are Darwin own voice, eligible grounding in principle without synthetic question.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1151: Explicit February4,1848. Accepts geology commission under Herschel supervision, conditional on future quality, cannot start about a week because dissection would be spoiled. Coral remarks already prepared for Owen before knowing geology commission; asks transfer to chapter, final printed placement later. Missing invitation and health consideration received; no original incoming letter. Published1849 instructions quoted in apparatus are not full contemporary commission text or an incoming prompt.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1164: Tuesday evening assigned March21,1848 from March20 completion, not independent proof sent first Tuesday. Missing Herschel note received this morning and forwarded to Mallet, whose acceptance of compression is expected rather than known. Manuscript enclosed, editing/shortening and book recommendations discussed; heading included conditionally, proofs and offprints requested. Postscript criticizes mere rock collecting, not all geological field collection. Manuscript later known lost: first enclosure statement is dispatch intent/report, not successful delivery. Later published chapter cannot silently replace missing manuscript version.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1173: May7 with supplied1848year. Post Office found no trace of lost manuscript parcel; now reports registered resend and asks acknowledgment, not proof arrived. Earlier letter1164 and enclosure apparently lost, later found at unspecified time per apparatus. Erasmus translated Élie de Beaumont slope method; text not reproduced here, and earlier727 calculations are a different artifact. Darwin/Erasmus uncertainty about artificial horizon precautions retained; request Herschel correction not completed answer. Extra copies/proofs desired and influenza recovery hoped, actual1849volume possession in apparatus later. No Post Office or Herschel incoming body.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1175: May11 with supplied1848year. Unsolicited observation offered because Herschel interested in colours. Blue Ibla valve material turns red under pressure/acids, potash no effect; composition as chitin is qualified belief and observations are historical report. Specimen offered conditionally, not sent until1183. Later published1851 account remains separate and no current Herschel request identified.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1183: June6 with supplied1848year. Encloses two Ibla valves in damp cotton and gives observation instructions; historical throw-away permission is not an instruction to agent. Willing to shorten manuscript but substantial reduction would require rewriting. Herschel June13 annotation reports no observed colour change and destroyed specimen during attempts: establishes his later examination, not Darwin knowledge on June6 or proof a reply reached Darwin. Disagreement remains attributed, not silently reconciled with Darwin observation or1851publication. No incoming Herschel text preserved as an independent letter.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1246: June13 with supplied1849year, Malvern. Thanks missing Herschel note/precautions about printing complaint and separate Murray note thought written before Herschel contacted him; ordering explicitly uncertain. All will be made right is expectation, not verification printing corrected. Three months water cure with marked claimed improvement, historical symptom/efficacy account not current clinical guidance. Earlier quackery view now revised, do not harmonize. No Murray/Herschel incoming source endpoint, and printed volume does not substitute for note.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-430: Fresh full context reading, Friday2 assigned November1838 because Herschel returned May and only later Friday2 fits. Relays Macleay request for net mesh/material after Herschel oral catching advice. Oral source, missed personal question and upcoming Australia departure distinguished; no incoming Herschel letter. No connection to later geology commission or colour specimens merely from correspondent identity.

Six-shilling boxes paid, replacement size and two-shilling difference proposed; address in separate paragraphs. Later directory/payment context and adult UniversityClub address, with no family childhood news, do not match1848Willy notes. Original uncertain dating retained, not converted into firm1876day. No current-period input.
